Strategy: Reward post-placement residuals that can still fit another item at least half as large, and penalize near-dead slivers below a quarter item, on top of Best Fit tightness. The band edges scale with the item size rather than fixed numbers. It may help by preserving bins that stay useful, but may fail if the item-size distribution makes half-item leftovers rare.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= item / 2 and r - item <= item else 0) - (25 if r - item > 0 and r - item < item / 4 else 0) for r in bins]
```
